summary: PR template and pr-gates record author/reviewer models; fail on same model, warn on shared provider; Copilot allowed as reviewer.
migration_impact: Adopters should import updated PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md and plate-pr-gates.yml; fill Agent review models table on new PRs.
migration_guidance: 1. Run gh plate import-payload (dry-run, then apply) for plate-pr-gates.yml and PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md, or regenerate gates with scripts/build_plate_pr_gates_workflow.py after upgrading plate-core.
2. Fill Author model and Reviewer model in every Feature/Bug/Documentation PR; use copilot for GitHub Copilot code review when the author was an agent model.
3. Human merge approval requirements are unchanged; this gate only blocks identical author/reviewer model ids.
agent_notes: Parse the Agent review models table in the PR body. Same normalized model id fails; same provider with different models emits a workflow warning only.
